name: POST /api/admin/dialer/inbound/admit - Admit an inbound call to capacity
description: Operator-only (x-admin-ops-token), called by the voice runtime when a routed inbound call arrives (180f8a01-0600-48b4-a0e5-f1be092f2fb3#AC3 — inbound calls are served before queued outbound dispatch on the same capacity). Inbound calls never wait in the dispatch queue: they are admitted immediately against the FULL plan/key cap, while outbound dispatch stops short of it by DIALER_INBOUND_RESERVE_PCT (default 10%), so outbound can never take the headroom an inbound caller needs. Body: tenant_id, call_id (an inbound call). Returns {admitted, decision: {granted, blocked_by, caps, key_ref, backend}}; when not admitted the runtime takes the number's fallback (voicemail / forward). Admitted calls become in_progress.

errorCases.message: tenant_id and call_id must be uuids

errorCases.when: no such call for the tenant

errorCases.message: only inbound calls are admitted this way | call already ended as <status>

errorCases.when: x-admin-ops-token missing or not a valid operator token
